issue_context.body:
<!-- READ THIS FIRST:
  - If you need additional help with this template, please refer to https://www.home-assistant.io/help/reporting_issues/
  - Make sure you are running the latest version of Home Assistant before reporting an issue: https://github.com/home-assistant/core/releases
  - Do not report issues for integrations if you are using custom components or integrations.
  - Provide as many details as possible. Paste logs, configuration samples and code into the backticks.
  DO NOT DELETE ANY TEXT from this template! Otherwise, your issue may be closed without comment.
-->
## The problem
See also: https://community.home-assistant.io/t/proliphix-thermostat-error/187202

After adding the proliphix component to the configuration file, as described on https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/proliphix/

The proliphix component does not start, giving the error:
KeyError: 'DevName'
int the home-assistant.log file.

## Environment
<!--
  Provide details about the versions you are using, which helps us to reproduce
  and find the issue quicker. Version information is found in the
  Home Assistant frontend: Developer tools -> Info.
-->

- Home Assistant Core release with the issue: Home Assistant 0.108.6
- Last working Home Assistant Core release (if known): Unknown
- Operating environment (Home Assistant/Supervised/Docker/venv): Home Assistant
- Integration causing this issue: Unknown
- Link to integration documentation on our website: Unknown

## Problem-relevant `configuration.yaml`
<!--
  An example configuration that caused the problem for you. Fill this out even
  if it seems unimportant to you. Please be sure to remove personal information
  like passwords, private URLs and other credentials.
-->

```yaml
climate:
  - platform: proliphix
    host: IP_ADDRESS
    username: YOUR_USERNAME
    password: YOUR_PASSWORD
```

## Traceback/Error logs
<!--
  If you come across any trace or error logs, please provide them.
-->

```txt
2020-04-18 21:26:00 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.climate] Error while setting up proliphix platform for climate
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/helpers/entity_platform.py", line 178, in _async_setup_platform
    await asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.shield(task), SLOW_SETUP_MAX_WAIT)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.7/asyncio/tasks.py", line 442, in wait_for
    return fut.result()
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.7/concurrent/futures/thread.py", line 57, in run
    result = self.fn(*self.args, **self.kwargs)
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/proliphix/climate.py", line 41, in setup_platform
    add_entities([ProliphixThermostat(pdp)], True)
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/proliphix/climate.py", line 50, in __init__
    self._name = self._pdp.name
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.7/site-packages/proliphix/proliphix.py", line 183, in name
    return self._data['DevName']
KeyError: 'DevName'
```

## Additional information
I think I already have a fix for the problem.

The climate.py module does not call pdp.update() before calling add_entities. This means that the proliphix modules has not retrieved any data yet, including the device name.

When making this fix I ran into another problem: the climate.py module tries to use the property hvac_mode, wheras the proliphix module only provides hvac_state.

I will make a pull request with my solution that refers to this issue.

review_comments:
From how I read the [prolifix api docs](https://github.com/snappa/thermostat.rb/blob/master/docs/PDP_API_R1_11.pdf) the `thermHvacState` with OID 4.1.2, here represented by `self._pdp.hvac_state`, represents the state of the HVAC, ie if it's inactive, cooling or heating at the current time. In home assistant this should be returned by the `hvac_action` property.

The `hvac_mode` property, here, should return what mode the HVAC is set to, ie if the user wants it to heat or cool etc.

https://github.com/sdague/proliphix/blob/da2cb3f2193ecc5887ec0eac7265e681a59f6186/proliphix/proliphix.py#L36-L53

We want to use `thermHvacMode`, OID 4.1.1, for `hvac_mode`. The only public interface that uses that in the library are these two properties, `is_cooling` and `is_heating`:
https://github.com/sdague/proliphix/blob/da2cb3f2193ecc5887ec0eac7265e681a59f6186/proliphix/proliphix.py#L134-L140

It would be good if the library could expose all the modes, since there seems to be off and auto besides heating and cooling.
Not sure how to test the various methods or actions available but these changes now allow my system to read the proliphix thermostat status.

Hi Martin,

I think what you want requires a change to the proliphix package from pypi.org?  I'm willing to look into that, but it seems to go a bit beyond the original bug fix to get the basic thermostat functionality running on home assistant.

Regards,

Martijn
For this PR it's enough to add a property `hvac_action` that returns `self._pdp.hvac_state`, and check `self._pdp.is_cooling` and `self._pdp.is_heating` here in `hvac_mode`.
Ok, I changed the code. This seems to work in my setup.

This should not be needed since we call `add_entities` with second argument `True` below. That makes sure that the entity `update` method is called during entity addition. The entity `update` method calls `self._pdp.update`.

I tried removing it, but then the error returns:

```
2020-04-22 18:59:15 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.climate] Error while setting up proliphix platform for climate
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/helpers/entity_platform.py", line 178, in _async_setup_platform
    await asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.shield(task), SLOW_SETUP_MAX_WAIT)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.7/asyncio/tasks.py", line 442, in wait_for
    return fut.result()
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.7/concurrent/futures/thread.py", line 57, in run
    result = self.fn(*self.args, **self.kwargs)
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/proliphix/climate.py", line 41, in setup_platform
    add_entities([ProliphixThermostat(pdp)], True)
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/proliphix/climate.py", line 50, in __init__
    self._name = self._pdp.name
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.7/site-packages/proliphix/proliphix.py", line 184, in name
    return self._data['DevName']
KeyError: 'DevName'
```

Maybe the update is called after the name property is retrieved?

Ah, I see, in the add_entities call, the ProliphixThermostat constructor is called. That constructor tries to access the self._pdp.name poperty, which has not been set yet.

I can think of several ways to solve this, I am not sure what the preferred one is?
1) Leave the pdp.update() call where I put it initially.
2) Have ProliphixThermostat.__init__ call the update function
3) Have ProliphixThermostat.update set the self._name after the call to self._pdp.update
Set name in `update`. In init default name to `None`.
Hi All, my apologies if this is not the right spot for a message but I am available to help test.  I have the nt150 thermostat and HA running and working, except for this "devname" error.
